We're Team Waveform, and this is the Earth Information Jukebox.
NASA's Earth data is made to be seen. We made it heard, for blind and low-vision people first.
Point at the ocean: the warmer the water, the higher the note.
Lightning seen from the Space Station plays as drums.
Dust, smoke, sea salt and sulfates each get their own sound.
With a narrated tour, captions and full keyboard support, anyone can hear our planet change.
